own_solution.law: Work-energy theorem: (1/2) k x^2 = mu_k m g d
assumptions: block starts from rest and moves
ideal massless spring, separation at natural length
kinetic friction over the whole slide

T92B0.regime: elastic limit above the 10 cm compression

T9B94.regime: elastic limit above the 10 cm compression

defect_reasons.other: The claims for the trolley sentences (TFBC0, TDC1D) label the quantity 'a weight fixed to the block' although the weight is fixed to the trolley; a metadata label slip that does not affect any answer or stratum.

notes: Checked all answers: base 4/1.225 = 3.26531 m; m+q = 1.2, 2.0, 2.7 kg give friction 2.94, 4.9, 6.615 N and distances 1.36054, 0.816327, 0.604686 m, all correct. In every R case the block still has positive kinetic energy at the spring's natural length (minimum 4 - 0.6615 = 3.34 J) and the spring force (80 N) exceeds friction, so s = E/Ff holds. K regime q > x = 0.10 m holds for 22, 28, 36 cm. Minimal pairs TFBC0/TB3C0 (trolley vs block) and T9D09/TC18C (earlier experiment vs before release) share 1.5 kg and differ only in attachment; numeral-free twins match. Agrees with my pass 1.
